tests.title: Practice paper (no university exam this semester)
tests.patternSource: INC B.Sc Nursing Regulations 2020, Appendix 3 (university theory question paper pattern), 75-mark paper. Nursing Foundation I has no end-semester university exam; its internal marks are added to Nursing Foundation II, and the university paper 'Nursing Foundations (I & II)' (3 hours, 75 marks) is taken at the end of the second semester. This practice paper uses that pattern with Part I topics only. No internal choice. Confirm with your university.
